cases.name: token-usage is model-invocable with a description of at most 240 characters and a lean body; the four ws-* skills are user-invoked, one-line, lean
every rule of the packs usage and repo-orkeon-workshop is scoped by a paths: front matter (none is always on)
cases.cmd:
P={{CLAUDE}}/../packs; [ -d "$P/usage" ] && [ -d "$P/repo-orkeon-workshop" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs folder beside the harness - a deployed workshop)'; exit 0; }; python3 -c 'import glob, os, re, sys
rules = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(sys.argv[1], "repo-orkeon-workshop/claude/rules/*.md")) + glob.glob(os.path.join(sys.argv[1], "usage/claude/rules/*.md")))
bad = [os.path.basename(r) for r in rules
       if not re.match(r'"'"'---\npaths:\n(  - "[^"\n]+"\n)+---\n'"'"', open(r, encoding="utf-8").read())]
if not rules: bad.append("no-rule")
summary = "%d rules, all scoped by paths:" % len(rules)

if bad:
    sys.stdout.write("FAIL " + " ".join(bad))
    sys.exit(1)
sys.stdout.write("ok (" + summary + ")")
' "$P"

cases.name: the files of the packs usage and repo-orkeon-workshop carry no accented letter
cases.cmd:
P={{CLAUDE}}/../packs; [ -d "$P/usage" ] && [ -d "$P/repo-orkeon-workshop" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs folder beside the harness - a deployed workshop)'; exit 0; }; python3 -c 'import io, os, re, sys
rx = re.compile("[àâçéèêëîïôùûœÀÉÈÊ]")
paths = []
for pack in ("usage", "repo-orkeon-workshop"):
    for root, _, files in os.walk(os.path.join(sys.argv[1], pack)):
        paths += [os.path.join(root, n) for n in files]
bad = sorted(p for p in paths if rx.search(io.open(p, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()))
summary = "%d files, no accented letter" % len(paths)

if bad:
    sys.stdout.write("FAIL " + " ".join(bad))
    sys.exit(1)
sys.stdout.write("ok (" + summary + ")")
' "$P"

cases.name: repo.yaml parses, holds the keys the skills read (every commands./manual_checks./docs_mirror./orkeon_pin. key a ws-* skill names), and in the repository every file of the migration checklist exists
cases.cmd:
P={{CLAUDE}}/../packs; [ -d "$P/usage" ] && [ -d "$P/repo-orkeon-workshop" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs folder beside the harness - a deployed workshop)'; exit 0; }; python3 -c 'import yaml' 2>/dev/null || { printf 'ok (skipped: PyYAML is missing)'; exit 0; }; python3 -c 'import glob, os, re, sys, yaml
P, root = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
pack = os.path.join(P, "repo-orkeon-workshop")
d = yaml.safe_load(open(os.path.join(pack, "references/repo.yaml"), encoding="utf-8"))
want = {"": ["product", "origin", "commands", "manual_checks", "docs_mirror", "orkeon_pin", "contrib", "release"],
        "manual_checks": ["ci_replay", "docs"],
        "commands": ["build", "lint", "test", "test_integration", "image", "docs_checks"],
        "docs_mirror": ["english", "french", "english_only", "toc", "index"],
        "orkeon_pin": ["resolve", "pinned", "files"], "release": ["tag", "workflows", "channels"]}
bad = ["missing:" + (k + "." if k else "") + key for k, keys in want.items() for key in keys
       if key not in (d.get(k) or {} if k else d)]
# Every key a ws-* skill names exists.
named = set()
for s in glob.glob(os.path.join(pack, "claude/skills/*/SKILL.md")):
    named |= set(re.findall(r"`((?:commands|manual_checks|docs_mirror|orkeon_pin)\.[a-z_]+)", open(s, encoding="utf-8").read()))
bad += sorted("named:" + k for k in named if k.split(".")[1] not in (d.get(k.split(".")[0]) or {}))
# In the repository itself, every file the migration checklist names exists.
where = "outside the repository"
if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(root, ".github/workflows/image.yml")):
    where = "files checked in the repository"
    for entry in (d["orkeon_pin"]["files"] + [d["record"], d["instructions"]] + d["docs_mirror"]["toc"]
                  + d["docs_mirror"]["index"] + d["docs_mirror"]["english_only"]):
        if not glob.glob(os.path.join(root, entry)):
            bad.append("gone:" + entry)
summary = "%d keys named by the skills, %s" % (len(named), where)

if bad:
    sys.stdout.write("FAIL " + " ".join(bad))
    sys.exit(1)
sys.stdout.write("ok (" + summary + ")")
' "$P" {{CLAUDE}}/../../..

cases.name: cc-usage: its unit tests pass from the sources when they are reachable; else the installed command reads a session under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and prints its (startup) tokens as JSON
cases.cmd: export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; c={{CLAUDE}}/../../cc-usage; if [ -f "$c/tests/test_workshop_changes.py" ]; then (cd "$c" && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .) > {{FIX}}/unittest-{{SID}}.log 2>&1; rc=$?; ran=$(grep -o '^Ran [0-9]* tests' {{FIX}}/unittest-{{SID}}.log); last=$(tail -n 1 {{FIX}}/unittest-{{SID}}.log); if [ "$rc" = 0 ] && [ "$last" = OK ]; then printf 'ok (sources: %s)' "$ran"; else printf 'FAIL rc=%s\n' "$rc"; tail -n 30 {{FIX}}/unittest-{{SID}}.log; exit 1; fi; elif command -v cc-usage >/dev/null 2>&1; then d={{FIX}}/ccd-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$d/projects/-workspace-smoke" "$d/home"; cp {{FIX}}/smoke-session.jsonl "$d/projects/-workspace-smoke/"; s=$(HOME="$d/home" CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR="$d" cc-usage --no-fetch --session smoke-session --json | python3 -c 'import json, sys; print(sum(s["added"] for s in json.load(sys.stdin)["sources"] if s["tool"] == "(startup)"))'); if [ "$s" = 580 ]; then printf 'ok (command: startup=%s)' "$s"; else printf 'FAIL startup=%s' "$s"; exit 1; fi; else printf 'ok (skipped: neither the cc-usage sources nor the cc-usage command are reachable)'; fi
